svg.aria-label: Pin map for an MS43 Touring built 09/2001 to 02/2003, with an M3 donor built from 09/2001: the DME plug X60004, two blocks of two rows of ten, and the body side of the E-box plug X6011, two rows of four, laid out as WDS draws them. WDS doesn't say which face that is, so your plug may look mirrored: find each cavity by the number moulded on the housing, never by counting positions in the drawing. Five wires move from X6011 into X60004: the oil-pressure lamp from 3 to 11, the charge lamp from 4 to 1, the oil level from 5 to 21, the start feedback from 6 to 2 and the leak-test heater from 7 to 18. Once the heater wire is out, the clutch wire moves from X60004 pin 23 into X6011 pin 7, and the brake test contact moves from 28 to 34. New wires go into 5, a ground to X1108 (recommended), and into 15 and 16 for the optional Sport button. X60004 pin 6 stays empty. Every wire that moves between X6011 and X60004 needs a new terminal of the target's type, or a BMW repair lead, and the cluster's three lamp switches are coded to nicht_aktiv.
svg.text: MS43 TOURING: X60004 AND BODY X6011
For a Touring built 09/2001 to 02/2003, with an M3 donor built from 09/2001.
Layout as WDS draws it. WDS doesn't say which face that is,
so your plug may look mirrored: find each cavity by the number
moulded on the housing, never by counting positions in this
In WDS, X60001/2/3/5 run the other way:
empty → 0.35 BL from body X6011 pin 4
empty → 0.35 SW/GN from body X6011 pin 6
empty → new 0.35 BR/SW to ground point X1108
a forum mapping put the start feedback here; it goes in 2
empty → 0.35 BR/GN from body X6011 pin 3
empty → new 0.35 SW/RT/GE from X1869 pin 17
empty → new 0.35 SW/GR/GE to X1869 pin 18
empty → 0.75 SW/RT from body X6011 pin 7
empty → 0.5 WS/GN from body X6011 pin 5
0.35 BL/BR → empty: the wire goes to body X6011 pin 7
fit the M3's 61319122700 in place of 61319231129
Order: move #1 takes the heater wire out of body X6011 pin 7 before move #2 puts the clutch wire in.
Every wire that moves between X6011 and X60004 needs a new terminal of the target's type, or a BMW repair lead.
Code the cluster's CAN_OELDRUCKSCHALTER, GENERATOR_UEBER_CAN and TOG_UEBER_CAN to nicht_aktiv.
No change: pin 10 (pump relay K96); pins 20 and 30 (leak-test pump: test before your Touring's DME comes out).
Built before 09/2001? Body X6011 pin 7 is empty and the leak-test module has no heater: see “Earlier MS43 Tourings” in the manual.
Wire colors: SW black, WS white, RT red, GN green, BL blue, BR brown, GE yellow, GR gray, VI violet, OR orange.
0.35 BR/GR = 0.35 mm², brown with a gray tracer.
